title: Bass Tagine Tacos
description: A fusion of Mexican and Moroccan flavors, featuring sea bass cooked in a flavorful tagine sauce, served in tacos.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the diced tomatoes, chicken broth, moroccan spice blend, cumin, and salt.
Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Add the sea bass fillets to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Transfer the cooked bass to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by placing a piece of cooked bass onto a tortilla, followed by a spoonful of the tagine sauce and some chopped cilantro.
